name: Trap
tagline: A voice calling itself 'Rex' lures the survivors to a rooftop for a final stand.
summary: Trap is the third chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 1, set on a small square rooftop ringed by buildings. After defending the ruined construction site, the survivors hear a mysterious voice from someone calling himself 'Rex'. Commander Andrey gathers the survivors on the rooftop - the source of the sound - for a final battle for survival, but the advance force is annihilated by endless zombies.
story: The wiki's story summary: after defending the destroyed construction site, the survivors hear a mysterious voice from someone calling himself "Rex". Commander Andrey gathers the survivors to the rooftop, the source of the sound, for a "final battle for survival", but the advance force faces "annihilation by endless zombies" - the trap of the title. Their fate is picked up in the next chapter, Last Clue, where a rescue team finds Andrey's body and his notebook.
objectives: Survive on the rooftop for 5 rounds with a 3-minute time limit per round.
Spawn in the centre rooftop surrounded by buildings; zombies climb in from all sides.
Both green and red Regular Zombies on this map throw accurate zombie grenades.
rewards: Honor mission: clear Trap 400 times - medal described as given to a player who has cleared the Zombie Scenario Trap map 400 times
trivia: The MOTEL billboard displays real-life logos (HBO, MTV, ESPN, CNN).
A blood-splatter easter egg can be triggered by slashing the centre of the ground with certain melee weapons.
Originally 50 rounds of 2 minutes, later reduced to 30 and then to the current 5 rounds.
Wiki tips: speed-based characters with medium-high health and A-tier or SS-tier weapons are recommended.
